label: EXPLORATORY: Jaaks 2022 is exposed (opened by feedback_validation_20261003); every result of this plan is exploratory; verdicts carry the EXPLORATORY_ prefix
outcome_access: only common.exposed_ticket(purpose, 'design') (one logged access per stage) + the frozen jaaks.build_panels; event labels of repeat lines via model_id.event_table with the same ticket

stages.name: dev
stages.data: HD lines only: every E row removed from both role panels before any computation; history = other HD lines of the tissue
stages.runs: P2 (measurement cap) for R, S_both, L_v, C_s, C_v, C_mean, C_prod, S, oracle x fp in {10,...,60}; P3 for all; gate campaigns (R round 1 + oracle round 2, same count; variant with the reserve rule); menu metrics
writes: design/selection.json (C*, integer fp*, R's own fp, every predictor's own fp, full development table, in-sample R - C*, power)
design/results/dev_<stamp>/ (per-campaign JSONL.gz: P2 grid, P3, gate; menu metrics; dev_summary.json)

stages.name: feedback_dev
stages.condition: only if feedback_gate.json pass = true (else writes feedback_fit.json with run = false)
stages.data: HD campaigns only; TransferWorld(WorldConfig(context=False)) on the role panel with every E line excluded
stages.runs: R's P3 round 1; F = posterior - prior from purchased round-1 screen labels; m_line, f_i on the eligible set; fit F0, Fm, Ff (b > 0), c_f line bootstrap (10,000), lambda; in-sample HD evaluation

stages.name: addendum
writes: design/plan_addendum_1.json: sha256 of selection.json, feedback_gate.json, feedback_fit.json and the code, before any E outcome is used

stages.name: eval
stages.data: E targets, history = all HD lines; all-lines sensitivity: every line, history = all other lines
stages.runs: primary R - C* under P2 at fp* (decision rule, EXPLORATORY_ prefix, H2 qualification); own-fp secondary; R - each simple predictor; S_both - S, R - S; P3 R - C*, R - S_both; wells cap R - C*; LOO 125 R - C*; menu >= 10; two-way line x pair bootstrap; SV / VS diagnostic; concordance, Brier/log loss (R, C_prod); consumption, hits, verifications, confirmation rate, missed, rounds used, native plates and seeding events; menu QC exclusions per line (M1); pipeline diagnostic

stages.name: feedback_eval
stages.condition: feedback_fit.json run = true; addendum hashes match
stages.runs: E role-swapped campaigns (worlds without other E lines) with the HD coefficients: AUC among eligible round-2 candidates, calibration-in-the-large, log loss, P3 yield for R, F0, Fm, Ff, U_lambda, U_screen_post, U_V0; registered diagnostic decision; same-condition repeat lines (development-grade)

inference: registered tissue-stratified line bootstrap (default_rng(20261004), lines sorted by SIDM within tissue, 10,000, percentile [2.5, 97.5]); two-way bootstrap default_rng(20261005)
never: editing this plan after an outcome read (deviations go to design/receipts/deviations.json and addenda)
